solution:
Here the correct answer is Could.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The sentence structure suggests that the sentence talks about Voltaire's actions in the past.
 
• The phrase **"he could not be true to himself"** implies that there were some things he wanted to do but felt unable to.
 
• In general, "could" is the past tense of "can" and is used to indicate ability or possibility in the past.
